description: Slovak company annual accounts: list the fiscal years of a Slovak company whose STRUCTURED financial statements have been decoded from the official Register účtovných závierok (RÚZ, registeruz.sk, Ministry of Finance, CC0): closing date, period, filing type (ordinary/extraordinary), form model, statutory vs consolidated scope, and the official document link. Filings served as PDF only (which includes every IFRS group) carry no structured data and are absent: an empty answer does not mean no accounts exist. Only units whose legal form is a served legal person's: any other (sole trader, 752 association of natural persons, form left unread) returns 404, not billed (GDPR minimisation). No default-risk score is computed for this country yet: the response carries score_defaillance (statut non_evaluable, closed-list reasons, explained by GET /v1/lecture); never read it as a low score. Paid via x402 ($0.01 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: list_slovak_company_filings

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.
